source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #357 (branch fix/320-resource-validation at head b875a3196ba36583d4fd4e49b80fcf3891d75119 — the Codex P2 fix on top of the #320 change: a sub-ascribed type export now registers its fresh face identity in the type index space and in the export info, so a later (type $face) reference to the export denotes the face rather than the underlying resource; the tree also contains the #320 change merged with current main b20ed79513bbb12f6e4447158fd4028808ac129b (PR #353); ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45606680284, 45606698309 and 45606714950 against the branch and pull-request run 45605539246, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #357 (Codex P2 fix: register the fresh resource identity of a sub-ascribed type export in the type index and export info). The fix commit b875a31 sits on top of the tree re-baselined for #320 in c719506; its CI run tripped the gate on six series. Attribution was isolated two ways. Against the previous branch head’s measurements (workflow_dispatch runs 45598730533, 45598745727 and 45598759671 on head daf55480a32bd26e89c499644a2044cbc425cd64, the tree the checked-in baseline was taken from), the delta is confined to the six release-size series of the three configurations that link telomere-component: stripped file and stripped .text +48 B in each of component, wasi and wasi-threads; every other series is byte-identical. Against unmodified main (workflow_dispatch runs 45598772332, 45598789232 and 45598803018 on main at b20ed79513bbb12f6e4447158fd4028808ac129b, unchanged since those runs), the delta remains the twelve series recorded for #320, with the release-size component-linking series a further +48 B. All six series exceed the checked-in baseline, so those six are re-baselined to the branch measurements. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the four branch samples. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is unchanged: the release component stripped file series at +11.14% (2,433,656 B to 2,704,688 B); the release core-nosimd stripped file series is unchanged at +9.83% (1,275,448 B to 1,400,840 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison.
